description: Bank cash flow skeleton using all 327 supplied unique US-GAAP concepts. Presentation families are guided by the supplied JPMorgan reference presentation cash flow statement; taxonomy definitions govern concept scope. Classification is provisional and does not establish arithmetic, equivalence or complete statement coverage.
classification_notes: All supplied concepts are mapped exactly once. Each has its own node so alternative scopes and measurement bases remain distinct.

The reference is a presentation guide, not a source of taxonomy equivalence, XBRL units, calculation relationships or fact signs. PDF zeros and dashes are not evidence for zero or missing source facts.
Groups include operating earnings adjustments and asset/liability changes, investment purchases/sales, lending, business transactions, customer deposit funding, equity, debt and dividends.

No mapped subtotal is invented for operating CF before asset/liability changes, net operating-asset/liability movements, free cash flow or exchange-rate effect. The supplied reconciliation-adjustment total is not equivalent to the first reference presentation subtotal.
Customer deposits are liabilities; deposits placed with banks are assets. FHLB/Federal Reserve stock investments differ from FHLB advances and interbank borrowing liabilities.
Net/gross, total/component, instrument and maturity views may overlap. Classification notes state shared cautions; review reasons identify concept-specific unresolved issues.
Source fact signs are preserved. IncreaseDecreaseIn concepts do not receive a universal inversion; gains/losses require reconciliation to earnings and cash-flow presentation.
Instant balances, percent rates, noncash acquisitions and OCI transfers remain outside cash receipts/payments. Supplementary facts may overlap primary amounts.
No direct-method statement is inferred from supplemental interest/tax payment disclosures. No new calculation or production-ready mapping is implied by proposed status.

metadata_contract.period_type: Verified from the 2026 taxonomy for every concept. Duration cash flows and instant balance/rate disclosures retain distinct context types.
metadata_contract.unit_type: monetary for amounts; percent for DebtWeightedAverageInterestRate. Percent uses an XBRL pure unit and requires explicit display scaling.
metadata_contract.contra: False does not set cash-flow direction. Expenses, proceeds, payments, signed movements and reversal adjustments require concept-specific fact context.
metadata_contract.review_reason: Required and concept-specific for review mappings; shared non-additivity and presentation cautions belong in classification_note.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata verified against the official 2026 schema; ambiguity-sensitive placements checked against official definitions. Historical facts require their own taxonomy-version and unit context.

details.note: Supplied PDF, pages 1–2. Used only as a presentation guide; no financial values, unsupported totals or display signs are imported.

nodes.label: Operating activities
nodes.classification_note: The primary operating total and alternative reported aggregates are separated to avoid presenting overlapping totals as additive items.

children.label: Cash flow from operating activities
children.classification_note: Reported operating cash flow is the primary total. Indirect adjustments, gross held-for-sale flows and payment details can overlap; this hierarchy does not prescribe their sum.

children.label: Income starting point alternatives
children.classification_note: Consolidated, parent-attributable, continuing and discontinued income measures have different scopes. Choose the income starting point matching the operating cash-flow reconciliation.

children.label: Net income (loss) attributable to the reporting entity

concepts.review_reason: Reporting-entity net income can exclude noncontrolling-interest income included in consolidated operating cash flow; reconcile the starting income scope.

children.label: Consolidated profit (loss)

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProfitLoss
concepts.review_reason: Consolidated profit includes noncontrolling interests and is not equivalent to the supplied reporting-entity NetIncomeLoss starting amount.

children.label: Income (loss) from continuing operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperations

children.label: Income loss from discontinued operations net of tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTax

children.label: Discontinued operations income, net of tax, attributable to the reporting entity

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromDiscontinuedOperationsNetOfTaxAttributableToReportingEntity
concepts.review_reason: Discontinued-operations income attributable to the reporting entity excludes other ownership interests; do not treat it as a cash-flow subtotal.

children.label: Noncash and other earnings adjustments
children.classification_note: These adjustments organize the earnings-to-cash bridge. No supplied concept is assumed to equal reference presentation operating CF before asset/liability changes; the group is not a reported subtotal. Earnings adjustments must relate to amounts included in the selected income starting point; reverse their earnings effect separately from the actual receipt or payment.

children.label: Depreciation, amortization and accretion
children.classification_note: Aggregate and component depreciation, amortization and accretion disclosures overlap. No parent-to-child sum or universal reversal sign is prescribed.

children.label: Reported depreciation and amortization aggregates
children.classification_note: These are overlapping aggregates with different depletion/accretion coverage. Select the applicable reported adjustment; do not add alternative totals.

children.label: Deferred income tax expense (benefit)

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit

children.label: Deferred federal income tax expense benefit

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeferredFederalIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit

children.label: Increase decrease in deferred income taxes

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInDeferredIncomeTaxes

children.label: Deferred income taxes and tax credits

children.label: Tax benefit from stock option exercises

concepts.name: us-gaap:EmployeeServiceShareBasedCompensationTaxBenefitFromExerciseOfStockOptions
concepts.review_reason: Tax benefits from stock option exercises depend on the filing period and applicable cash-flow presentation; do not infer a separate financing cash inflow.

children.label: Impairment and valuation adjustments

children.label: Goodwill impairment loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill impairment can already be included in the broader impairment adjustment; identify the goodwill-only add-back.

children.label: Asset impairment charges

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetImpairmentCharges

children.label: Impairment of real estate

children.label: Mortgage servicing rights MSR impairment recovery

concepts.name: us-gaap:MortgageServicingRightsMSRImpairmentRecovery

children.label: Impairment of long lived assets to be disposed of

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeDisposedOf

children.label: Impairment of long lived assets held for use

children.label: Real estate owned valuation allowance provision

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateOwnedValuationAllowanceProvision1

children.label: Impairment of intangible assets excluding goodwill

concepts.review_reason: Net interest payable changes may already be included in accrued-liability movements; isolate the interest component before using this detail.

children.label: Increase decrease in accrued liabilities and other operating liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilitiesAndOtherOperatingLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: This combined accrued-and-other-operating-liability movement can include both separately supplied categories; it is an overlapping aggregate.

children.label: Increase decrease in accrued liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Accrued liabilities can include interest and tax payable changes disclosed separately; determine the residual coverage.

children.label: Increase decrease in accounts payable and accrued liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInAccountsPayableAndAccruedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Accounts payable and accrued liabilities combines categories that may already be included in operating-liability changes; identify the accounts-payable increment.

children.label: Increase decrease in operating liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Operating-liability changes can encompass accrued liabilities and other operating liabilities supplied separately; choose a reconciled aggregate or its components.

children.label: Increase decrease in accrued income taxes payable
Increase decrease in operating lease liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOperatingLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease liability changes can include new leases and modifications; do not treat the full movement as cash rent or combine it unadjusted with ROU amortization.

children.label: Net operating capital changes
children.classification_note: A net operating-capital adjustment can contain both asset and liability movements shown separately. Use the aggregate or a reconciled component view, not both.

children.label: Increase decrease in other operating capital net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInOtherOperatingCapitalNet
concepts.review_reason: Other operating capital is a net asset/liability measure; identify which separately supplied operating movements it already nets together.

children.label: Held-for-sale loan cash flows
children.classification_note: Held-for-sale loan operating flows can already be reflected in held-for-sale balance-change adjustments. Do not combine a full balance adjustment and gross cash-flow presentation without reconciliation.

children.label: Held-for-sale loan origination and purchase payments
children.classification_note: Combined origination/purchase payments can include mortgage originations and all loan purchases; these are alternative breakdowns.

children.label: Payments for origination of mortgage loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForOriginationOfMortgageLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Mortgage held-for-sale originations exclude purchases and non-mortgage classes; distinguish this scope from combined origination-and-purchase payments.

children.label: Payments for origination and purchases of loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForOriginationAndPurchasesOfLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-sale origination-and-purchase payments can include mortgage originations and purchased loans supplied separately; reconcile rather than adding all views.

children.label: Payments to purchase loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToPurchaseLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Purchases of held-for-sale loans exclude originations and can already be included in the combined origination-and-purchase amount.

children.label: Held-for-sale loan sale and collection receipts
children.classification_note: Total loan sales can include mortgage and other-loan subsets. Sale-and-collection receipts have broader transaction coverage than sale-only measures.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: All held-for-sale loan sale proceeds can include mortgage and other-loan sale proceeds; reconcile the class breakdown before selecting this aggregate.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of mortgage loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Mortgage held-for-sale loan sales are a subset of all held-for-sale loan sales; distinguish sale proceeds from sale-and-collection receipts.

children.label: Proceeds from sale and collection of loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleAndCollectionOfLoansHeldforsale
concepts.review_reason: Held-for-sale sale-and-collection proceeds include a collection component absent from sale-only measures; establish whether both views cover the same loans.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of other loans held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherLoansHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Other held-for-sale loan sales exclude loan categories reported separately; identify those exclusions relative to the all-loan sale total.

children.label: Other operating cash flows
children.classification_note: Lease payments, pension contributions and other cash-flow lines may already be embedded in the indirect reconciliation; they are not automatic additional deductions.

children.label: Operating lease payments

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeasePayments
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease payments are cash outflows that may already be reflected through lease-related operating adjustments; do not deduct them a second time.

children.label: Finance lease interest payment on liability

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinanceLeaseInterestPaymentOnLiability
concepts.review_reason: Finance lease interest payments are operating cash flows under US GAAP and differ from financing principal payments; confirm they are already included in the operating total.

children.label: Pension contributions

concepts.name: us-gaap:PensionContributions
concepts.review_reason: Cash pension contributions are distinct from pension expense and may already be reflected in the liability-change reconciliation.

children.label: Other operating activities cash flow statement

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOperatingActivitiesCashFlowStatement
concepts.review_reason: Other operating activities is a residual cash-flow line, not an extra total above the specific operating cash flows and adjustments.

children.label: Operating cash-flow and reconciliation aggregate alternatives
children.classification_note: Continuing operating cash flow is an alternative operations scope. The reconciliation adjustment aggregate can include both noncash and operating asset/liability changes; neither is an extra component to add to operating cash flow.

children.label: Operating cash flow — continuing operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations
concepts.review_reason: Continuing-operations operating cash flow is narrower than the all-operations total and must not be added to that total.

children.label: Adjustments reconciling net income to operating cash flow

concepts.name: us-gaap:AdjustmentsToReconcileNetIncomeLossToCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities
concepts.review_reason: This reconciliation-adjustment aggregate can include both noncash items and operating asset/liability movements; it is not the reference presentation subtotal before asset/liability changes.

nodes.label: Cash flow from investing activities
nodes.classification_note: Reported investing cash flow is the total. The reference presentation guides the capital expenditure, investment, lending and business transaction families; overlapping net/gross measures are not a calculation tree.

children.label: Capital expenditures
children.classification_note: PP&E purchases can be included in productive-asset purchases. Intangible purchases have a separate asset scope; no net capital-expenditure subtotal is invented.

children.label: Payments to acquire property, plant and equipment
Payments to acquire productive assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Productive-asset purchases may cover PP&E and other productive assets; reconcile the acquisition scope with separately reported capital expenditures.

children.label: Payments to acquire intangible assets
Investment purchases, sales and maturities
children.classification_note: Investment flows are separated by portfolio and transaction basis. Broad totals, net measures and gross receipt components overlap and must not be summed by hierarchy.

children.label: AFS debt security cash flows
children.classification_note: Combined sales/maturities can contain separate sales and maturity/prepayment/call receipts. Do not add the combined amount to its detail or net purchases without a reconciliation.

children.label: Payments to acquire available-for-sale securities debt
Proceeds from sale of available-for-sale securities debt
Proceeds from maturities prepayments and calls of available-for-sale securities
Proceeds from sale and maturity of available-for-sale securities
HTM debt security cash flows
children.classification_note: Combined HTM sale/maturity receipts overlap individual receipt categories. HTM sales remain distinct from maturity/prepayment/call receipts.

children.label: Payments to acquire held-to-maturity securities
Proceeds from maturities prepayments and calls of held-to-maturity securities
Proceeds from sale of held-to-maturity securities
Proceeds from sale and maturity of held-to-maturity securities
FV-NI equity security cash flows
children.classification_note: Equity purchases and sale receipts are cash measures; fair-value changes and realized gains are retained among earnings adjustments.

children.label: Payments to acquire equity securities FV-NI
Proceeds from sale of equity securities FV-NI
Equity-method investment cash flows
children.classification_note: Purchases, disposals and explicit return-of-capital distributions are different transaction classes; general distributions elsewhere require classification before use.

children.label: Payments to acquire equity method investments
Proceeds from sale of equity method investments
Equity-method distributions — return of capital

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromEquityMethodInvestmentDividendsOrDistributionsReturnOfCapital
concepts.review_reason: Explicit return-of-capital distributions are investing receipts and can be included in the general equity-method distribution disclosure; do not count them twice.

children.label: Restricted investment cash flows
children.classification_note: Restricted investments are not the same as restricted cash. Identify cash-equivalent status before including purchases or sales as investing cash flow.

children.label: Payments to acquire restricted investments
Proceeds from sale of restricted investments
FHLB and Federal Reserve stock cash flows
children.classification_note: Net payments/proceeds overlap the corresponding gross purchases and sales. FHLB and Federal Reserve stock are investments, distinct from advances and borrowing liabilities.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from federal home loan bank stock
Payments to acquire federal home loan bank stock
Proceeds from sale of federal home loan bank stock
Payments to acquire federal reserve stock
Proceeds from sale of federal reserve stock
Payments for proceeds from federal reserve bank stock
Other investment cash flows
children.classification_note: Other-investment sale/maturity aggregates can include sale-only and maturity-only amounts. Trading securities explicitly held for investment differ from operating trading positions.

children.label: Payments to acquire other investments
Proceeds from sale of other investments
Proceeds from maturities prepayments and calls of other investments
Proceeds from sale and maturity of other investments
Proceeds from sale of trading securities held for investment
Broad investment cash-flow alternatives
children.classification_note: Broad marketable/all-investment purchase and receipt measures can cover several portfolio groups above. Net flows, gross purchases and combined receipts are alternative presentation levels, not additional investment categories.

children.label: Proceeds from sale and maturity of marketable securities
Payments to acquire marketable securities
Payments for proceeds from investments
Payments to acquire investments
Proceeds from sale maturity and collections of investments
Loan and lease investment cash flows
children.classification_note: Investing loans are distinguished from loans originated or purchased for resale. Select either reconciled net flows or appropriate gross detail; do not add both.

children.label: Net loan and lease cash flows
children.classification_note: Net lending measures differ from gross loan purchase/sale flows. The origination-and-collection concept is defined as an inflow and needs transaction-specific context; no uniform sign is imposed.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from loans and leases
Payments for proceeds from loans receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Net loan-receivable payments/proceeds can include origination and collection flows covered by other loan measures; identify the lending portfolio and netting basis.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from other loans and leases

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromOtherLoansAndLeases
concepts.review_reason: Other-loan-and-lease net flows exclude classes presented elsewhere; establish the residual definition relative to the broader loan-and-lease measure.

children.label: Loan and lease origination and principal collection inflows

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromLoanAndLeaseOriginationsAndPrincipalCollections1
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy defines this as cash inflow related to originations and principal collections; identify the reported transaction and direction rather than assuming originations are outflows.

children.label: Loan and lease purchases
children.classification_note: Loan, loan/lease and finance-receivable purchases have overlapping contract scopes. Held-for-investment detail can be included in broader purchase amounts.

children.label: Payments to acquire loans receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: Loan-receivable acquisition payments can include held-for-investment loan purchases; establish portfolio scope before selecting among acquisition measures.

children.label: Payments to acquire loans held for investment
Payments to acquire loans and leases held for investment
Payments to acquire finance receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireFinanceReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Finance-receivable acquisitions can overlap loan-receivable purchases but may cover different contracts; identify the financing assets acquired.

children.label: Loan and lease sales
children.classification_note: All-loan sale proceeds can include held-for-investment and finance-receivable subsets. Held-for-sale operating receipts are kept separate.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of loans held for investment
Proceeds from sale of loans and leases held for investment
Proceeds from sale of loans receivable

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfLoansReceivable
concepts.review_reason: All loan-receivable sale proceeds may encompass the separately supplied held-for-investment and finance-receivable sale amounts.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of finance receivables

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfFinanceReceivables
concepts.review_reason: Finance-receivable sale proceeds can overlap broader loan sale proceeds; establish the contract classes and holding intent.

children.label: Bank placements, federal funds sold and resale agreements
children.classification_note: Asset-side bank placements and resale agreements differ from customer deposits and funding repos. Cash-equivalent scope and overlapping combined/net measures require filing context.

children.label: Proceeds from payments for in interest bearing deposits in banks

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForInInterestBearingDepositsInBanks
concepts.review_reason: Interest-bearing deposits placed with banks are assets, unlike customer deposit liabilities; confirm whether the placements qualify as cash equivalents before assigning investing cash flow.

children.label: Increase decrease in federal funds sold

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsSold
concepts.review_reason: Federal funds sold changes describe asset-side placements; determine cash-equivalent scope and netting before assigning investing cash flow.

children.label: Resale agreement proceeds (payments), net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToResell
concepts.review_reason: Resale-agreement proceeds/payments are asset-side cash flows and can be included in the combined federal-funds-and-resale amount.

children.label: Federal funds sold and resale agreements — net cash flows

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForFederalFundsSoldAndSecuritiesPurchasedUnderAgreementsToResellNet
concepts.review_reason: The combined federal-funds-sold and resale-agreement net amount overlaps the separately supplied asset-side movements; use a reconciled combined or component presentation.

children.label: Business acquisitions and disposals
children.classification_note: Cash consideration is separated from purchase-price allocation and noncash equity consideration, which are in supplementary disclosures.

children.label: Business acquisition cash payments and acquired cash
children.classification_note: Gross payments, acquired cash and net acquisition payments are alternative reconciliation components. Excess acquired cash is a net inflow case, not extra proceeds to add to net acquisition cash.

children.label: Payments to acquire businesses net of cash acquired

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesNetOfCashAcquired
concepts.review_reason: Acquisition payments are already net of acquired cash; do not subtract acquired cash again or add gross payments to this amount.

children.label: Payments to acquire businesses gross

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireBusinessesGross
concepts.review_reason: Gross acquisition cash payments exclude cash acquired; reconcile them to the net acquisition payment rather than adding gross and net measures.

children.label: Cash acquired from acquisition

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashAcquiredFromAcquisition
concepts.review_reason: Cash acquired is a component of an acquisition cash-flow reconciliation, not an independent inflow to add to net-of-acquired-cash payments.

children.label: Cash acquired in excess of payments to acquire business

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashAcquiredInExcessOfPaymentsToAcquireBusiness
concepts.review_reason: Excess cash acquired over acquisition payments represents a net acquisition inflow, not additional cash on top of gross acquired cash.

children.label: Business divestiture receipts
children.classification_note: Divestiture proceeds before and after cash divested are alternative receipt bases.

children.label: Proceeds from divestiture of businesses

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinesses
concepts.review_reason: Gross divestiture proceeds differ from proceeds net of cash divested; establish which disposal cash basis the issuer reports.

children.label: Proceeds from divestiture of businesses net of cash divested

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromDivestitureOfBusinessesNetOfCashDivested
concepts.review_reason: Net divestiture proceeds already exclude cash divested; do not combine with the gross divestiture amount.

children.label: Net business and affiliate-interest cash flows
children.classification_note: This cross-transaction net measure may overlap gross acquisitions and divestitures or affiliate-interest transactions; identify coverage before selection.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from businesses and interest in affiliates

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromBusinessesAndInterestInAffiliates
concepts.review_reason: Business and affiliate-interest net flows can span acquisitions and disposals with different ownership scopes; reconcile to individual transaction cash flows.

children.label: Property and other asset disposal cash flows
children.classification_note: Asset sale receipts are distinct from earnings gains/losses reversed in operating activities. The property and asset classifications may overlap.

children.label: Productive asset sales and net flows
children.classification_note: Productive-asset sales can include PP&E. Net productive-asset payments/proceeds can overlap both sales and acquisition payments classified elsewhere.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment
Proceeds from sale of productive assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Productive-asset sale proceeds may include PP&E and other productive assets; distinguish its asset coverage from PP&E sale proceeds.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from productive assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromProductiveAssets
concepts.review_reason: Net productive-asset purchases/proceeds can include separately supplied acquisition and sale amounts; do not combine the net figure with gross components.

children.label: Real estate and foreclosed asset sale proceeds
children.classification_note: Foreclosed assets, other real estate and wholly owned/settlement property sales have overlapping collateral and property scopes; select the issuer-matching breakdown.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of other real estate

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Other-real-estate sale proceeds may be a subset of foreclosed-asset sale proceeds; establish the property coverage before choosing the aggregate.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of foreclosed assets

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfForeclosedAssets
concepts.review_reason: Foreclosed-asset sale proceeds can include non-real-estate collateral as well as other real estate; distinguish its broader asset scope.

children.label: Proceeds from owned real estate and real estate received in loan settlement

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfWhollyOwnedRealEstateAndRealEstateAcquiredInSettlementOfLoans
concepts.review_reason: This real-estate sale amount combines wholly owned property with property received in settlement of loans; it overlaps some foreclosed-property sale measures.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of property held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfPropertyHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Property-held-for-sale proceeds may include foreclosed or other property; establish which real-estate sale category contains the amount.

children.label: Other asset and MSR sale proceeds
children.classification_note: Other-asset sale proceeds can include MSR disposals. These cash receipts differ from asset sale gains and servicing valuation adjustments.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of mortgage servicing rights MSR

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfMortgageServicingRightsMSR
concepts.review_reason: MSR sale proceeds are cash receipts, distinct from servicing amortization and impairment adjustments; check whether included in other-asset sale proceeds.

children.label: Proceeds from sale of other assets investing activities

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromSaleOfOtherAssetsInvestingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Other-asset investing sale proceeds are a residual that can overlap productive-asset, property or servicing-right sales; determine exclusions.

children.label: Other investing cash flows
children.classification_note: Bank insurance policy transactions and residual investing flows remain distinct from securities and lending categories.

children.label: Life insurance policy cash flows
children.classification_note: Net policy payments/proceeds can contain gross premium payments and insurance receipts. Value changes in earnings are not these cash flows.

children.label: Proceeds from life insurance policies

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromLifeInsurancePolicies
concepts.review_reason: Life-insurance receipts may include surrenders and death benefits with different cash-flow treatment; inspect the nature of the receipt and separate earnings from cash proceeds.

children.label: Payments to acquire life insurance policies

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireLifeInsurancePolicies
concepts.review_reason: Life-insurance acquisition payments are cash investments in policies, not noncash changes in cash surrender value; confirm the reported investing classification.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from life insurance policies

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForProceedsFromLifeInsurancePolicies
concepts.review_reason: Net life-insurance policy payments/proceeds can include separately disclosed premiums and receipts; do not add the net measure to its gross components.

children.label: Investing insurance settlement receipts
children.classification_note: This concept explicitly covers investing settlements; other insurance recoveries require classification according to the underlying loss.

children.label: Proceeds from insurance settlement investing activities

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromInsuranceSettlementInvestingActivities
concepts.review_reason: Insurance settlements classified as investing must relate to investing assets; do not assume the same classification for operating insurance recoveries.

children.label: Residual investing cash flows
children.classification_note: Other investing payments/proceeds are a residual net flow and must exclude separately selected investment, lending or acquisition flows.

children.label: Payments for proceeds from other investing activities

nodes.label: Cash flow from financing activities
nodes.classification_note: Reported financing cash flow is the total. Customer deposits, equity, debt and distributions are presentation families, with overlapping total/component and net/gross disclosures.

children.label: Change in customer deposits
children.classification_note: Total deposit changes overlap product and domestic interest-bearing/noninterest-bearing breakdowns. Time, demand and other product views can intersect domestic funding categories; do not sum classification axes.

children.label: Increase decrease in deposits
Increase decrease in time deposits
Net change interest bearing deposits domestic
Net change noninterest bearing deposits domestic
Increase decrease in demand deposits
Increase decrease in other deposits
Stock issuance and repurchase cash flows
children.classification_note: Cash equity proceeds and repurchases are separated. Noncash stock issuance and acquisition equity consideration are supplementary, not cash funding.

children.label: Equity issuance cash proceeds
children.classification_note: Total equity issuance can include common/preferred shares, treasury sales, IPO and dividend reinvestment proceeds. Warrants issued and warrants exercised are different transactions; avoid double counting reported equity totals.

Proceeds from issuance of preferred stock and preference stock

Proceeds from issuance of warrants

Employee share plan cash proceeds

children.label: Proceeds from stock options exercised
Proceeds from stock plans
Share plan issuance proceeds including stock options
Share plan issuance proceeds
Equity repurchase cash payments
children.classification_note: Total equity repurchases can include common, preferred and redeemable preferred shares. Redeemable preferred classification depends on the issuer context; do not add totals to share-class detail.

children.label: Payments for repurchase of common stock
Payments for repurchase of preferred stock and preference stock
Payments for repurchase of redeemable preferred stock
Payments for repurchase of equity
Debt issuance and retirement cash flows
children.classification_note: Debt flows follow the long-term, short-term and other funding families. Net changes, gross issuance, repayments and lender-specific breakdowns overlap; no automatic aggregation is defined.

children.label: Net debt proceeds and repayments
children.classification_note: All-debt, maturity-specific and other-debt net measures overlap gross proceeds/repayments and can overlap each other. No net-debt subtotal is computed.

children.label: Debt proceeds (repayments), net
Short-term debt proceeds (repayments), net
Other debt proceeds (repayments), net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfOtherDebt
concepts.review_reason: Other-debt net proceeds/repayments can include short- and long-term other-debt components; establish exclusions relative to the all-debt net measure.

children.label: Long-term debt and capital securities proceeds (repayments), net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfLongTermDebtAndCapitalSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Long-term debt and capital-security net flows include a capital-security scope absent from plain long-term debt; identify the instruments and netting.

children.label: Debt maturing within three months — proceeds (repayments), net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromRepaymentsOfShortTermDebtMaturingInThreeMonthsOrLess
concepts.review_reason: Net short-term debt with maturities of three months or less is a maturity-specific subset; do not equate it with all short-term debt net flows.

children.label: Long-term debt proceeds and repayments
children.classification_note: Long-term totals can include senior, subordinated and other debt classes. Instrument-class repayments can have different maturity coverage from issuance measures.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of long term debt
Repayments of long term debt
Proceeds from issuance of subordinated long term debt
Repayments of subordinated debt

Repayments of other long term debt
Proceeds from issuance of senior long term debt
Repayments of senior debt
Short-term debt proceeds and repayments
children.classification_note: Short-term debt totals can include other short-term debt. Net short-term funding measures above must not be combined with gross proceeds or repayments.

children.label: Proceeds from short term debt
Repayments of short term debt
Proceeds from other short term debt
Repayments of other short term debt
FHLB borrowing and advance cash flows
children.classification_note: FHLB borrowings and advances can be alternative lender/instrument views within debt totals. Loans from another FHLBank are a separate inter-FHLBank borrowing context, not customer lending.

children.label: Proceeds from federal home loan bank borrowings

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowings
concepts.review_reason: FHLB borrowings proceeds can overlap proceeds described as FHLB advances; establish whether the issuer uses both labels for the same funding.

children.label: Proceeds from federal home loan bank advances

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances
concepts.review_reason: FHLB advance proceeds can be included in FHLB borrowing proceeds or debt issuance totals; reconcile the lender/instrument view.

children.label: Repayments of federal home loan bank borrowings

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepaymentsOfFederalHomeLoanBankBorrowings
concepts.review_reason: FHLB borrowing repayments can overlap payments for FHLB advances and broader debt repayments; establish the repayment coverage.

children.label: Payments for federal home loan bank advances

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsForFederalHomeLoanBankAdvances
concepts.review_reason: Payments for FHLB advances may be included in borrowing repayments; reconcile the advance-specific view with the FHLB borrowing measure.

children.label: Increase decrease in loans from other federal home loan banks

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInLoansFromOtherFederalHomeLoanBanks
concepts.review_reason: Loans from another FHLBank are inter-FHLBank borrowing flows; do not substitute this concept for a commercial bank's customer lending or generic FHLB advances.

children.label: Federal funds purchased and repo funding
children.classification_note: Combined purchased-funds/repo movements overlap the individual funding products. Asset-side sold funds and resale agreements are retained in investing candidates.

children.label: Repurchase agreement proceeds (payments), net

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsForInSecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchase
concepts.review_reason: Repurchase-agreement net flows describe borrowing-side transactions and can be included in the combined federal-funds-purchased and repo movement.

children.label: Federal funds purchased and repo balances — net change

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchasedAndSecuritiesSoldUnderAgreementsToRepurchaseNet
concepts.review_reason: Combined federal-funds-purchased and repo changes overlap the separately supplied purchased-funds and repo amounts; select a combined or reconciled component view.

children.label: Increase decrease in federal funds purchased

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncreaseDecreaseInFederalFundsPurchased
concepts.review_reason: Federal funds purchased are borrowing liabilities, unlike federal funds sold; this movement may be included in the broader combined funding amount.

children.label: Other and broad debt cash-flow alternatives
children.classification_note: All-debt proceeds and repayments can include other debt and notes payable. Instrument-specific and residual views are not incremental to the broad debt totals.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of debt
Repayments of debt
Proceeds from other debt
Repayments of other debt
Repayments of notes payable
Proceeds from notes payable
Payments of dividends
children.classification_note: Total cash dividends paid can include common and preferred payments below; do not add the total to its components. Stock dividends and dividend payable balances are supplementary.

children.label: Payments of dividends common stock
Payments of dividends preferred stock and preference stock
Finance lease principal payments
children.classification_note: Finance lease principal is a financing outflow; interest payments are retained in operating cash flows and noncash lease commencements in supplementary disclosures.

children.label: Finance lease principal payments
Other financing cash flows
children.classification_note: Withholding and issuance costs can be included in repurchase or net issuance amounts. Other financing net flows are residual; minority-shareholder transactions require ownership-change context.

children.label: Payments related to tax withholding for share based compensation

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation
concepts.review_reason: Share-based-compensation withholding payments can relate to shares withheld or repurchased for employee taxes; establish overlap with reported equity repurchases.

children.label: Payments of stock issuance costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfStockIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Stock issuance costs may already be netted against equity proceeds; identify gross versus net presentation before deducting them separately.

children.label: Payments of debt issuance costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:PaymentsOfDebtIssuanceCosts
concepts.review_reason: Debt issuance costs may already be netted against borrowings; separate cash issuance costs from noncash financing-cost amortization.

children.label: Proceeds from payments for other financing activities
Proceeds from payments to minority shareholders

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromPaymentsToMinorityShareholders
concepts.review_reason: Net cash flows with minority shareholders can represent ownership changes or distributions; identify the transaction before treating it as an equity issuance or dividend.

children.label: Security issuance requiring instrument review
children.classification_note: Private placement describes a distribution method rather than debt/equity type. Keep the concept outside those instrument groups until the security is identified.

children.label: Proceeds from issuance of private placement

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfPrivatePlacement
concepts.review_reason: Private-placement issuance proceeds do not establish debt versus equity from the concept name alone; identify the security before assigning a financing instrument group.

nodes.label: Cash movement and balance reconciliation
nodes.classification_note: All cash-flow totals, period changes and instant endpoints must use compatible cash scope and dates. No beginning/ending duplicate concept mapping or unsupported FX/FCF calculation is created.

children.label: Reported changes in cash
children.classification_note: Cash change including exchange effects and change excluding them are alternative measures. No standalone exchange-rate-effect concept is supplied; do not infer a mapped zero or silently omit the difference.

children.label: Change in cash and restricted cash, including FX

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalentsPeriodIncreaseDecreaseIncludingExchangeRateEffect
concepts.review_reason: This net cash change already includes the exchange-rate effect; do not add a separately derived exchange-rate effect again.

children.label: Change in cash and restricted cash, excluding FX

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalentsPeriodIncreaseDecreaseExcludingExchangeRateEffect
concepts.review_reason: This net cash change excludes the exchange-rate effect; reconcile it only with balances and exchange-rate effects of the same cash scope.

children.label: Cash and restricted cash balance scopes
children.classification_note: Beginning and ending balances use different instant contexts. Cash equivalents and restricted-cash balances are components or alternate scopes, not additional balances to add to a total.

children.label: Cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalents
concepts.review_reason: This cash reconciliation balance includes restricted cash; beginning and ending values require distinct instant contexts with a consistent scope.

children.label: Cash and restricted cash including disposal groups and discontinued operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashCashEquivalentsRestrictedCashAndRestrictedCashEquivalentsIncludingDisposalGroupAndDiscontinuedOperations
concepts.review_reason: This broader cash balance includes disposal groups and discontinued operations; do not substitute it for a narrower reconciliation scope.

children.label: Restricted cash and cash equivalents

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCashAndCashEquivalents
concepts.review_reason: Restricted cash and cash equivalents are components of broader cash reconciliation balances, not additional cash to add to those totals.

children.label: Restricted cash

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestrictedCash
concepts.review_reason: Restricted cash alone excludes restricted cash equivalents and can already be included in the combined restricted-cash disclosure.

children.label: Cash equivalents — carrying value

concepts.name: us-gaap:CashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue
concepts.review_reason: Cash equivalents alone exclude cash and restricted cash; they are a component rather than the full cash-flow reconciliation balance.

nodes.label: Supplementary cash-flow and noncash disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Supplementary facts are retained without treating accrual balances, noncash transactions, rates or overlapping payment disclosures as extra cash flows.

children.label: Supplementary cash payment disclosures
children.classification_note: Supplementary interest and tax disclosures may already be embedded in operating cash flow; do not add them as incremental payments.

children.label: Interest paid
children.classification_note: Gross and net interest paid are alternative measures and can include finance lease interest already disclosed in operating cash-flow detail.

children.label: Interest paid net

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestPaidNet
concepts.review_reason: Net interest paid differs from gross interest paid; identify the amounts netted before choosing between the two supplemental measures.

children.label: Interest paid

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestPaid
concepts.review_reason: Gross interest paid can contain finance lease interest already disclosed separately; do not add overlapping payment disclosures.

children.label: Income taxes paid and refunds
children.classification_note: Gross versus net payments and federal/state/local views overlap. Refunds are already reflected in net payment measures; these disclosures do not establish a direct-method operating statement.

children.label: Income taxes paid net

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet
concepts.review_reason: Net income taxes paid reflects refunds; do not add separately supplied refunds or gross payments without a reconciliation.

children.label: Income taxes paid

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaid
concepts.review_reason: Gross income tax payments differ from net-of-refund payments and jurisdiction-specific payment disclosures.

children.label: Income tax paid federal after refund received

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidFederalAfterRefundReceived
concepts.review_reason: Federal tax paid after refunds is a jurisdiction-specific net amount; distinguish it from federal gross payments and all-jurisdiction net tax.

children.label: Income tax paid state and local after refund received

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidStateAndLocalAfterRefundReceived
concepts.review_reason: State and local tax paid after refunds excludes federal and foreign tax; it is not an all-jurisdiction payment measure.

children.label: Proceeds from income tax refunds

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProceedsFromIncomeTaxRefunds
concepts.review_reason: Tax refunds are receipts already reflected in net tax paid; use them only to reconcile gross and net cash tax measures.

children.label: Income tax paid federal before refund received

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxPaidFederalBeforeRefundReceived
concepts.review_reason: Federal tax paid before refunds is a gross jurisdiction-specific amount; do not equate it with federal after-refund payments.

children.label: Tax expense, credits and reconciliation disclosures
children.classification_note: Accrual expense and tax-reconciliation credits are not cash taxes paid. They are retained for context, outside the primary cash-flow adjustment candidates.

children.label: Current income tax expense benefit

concepts.name: us-gaap:CurrentIncomeTaxExpenseBenefit
concepts.review_reason: Current tax expense is an accrual earnings component, not cash income taxes paid; retain it as a supporting tax disclosure.

children.label: Income tax reconciliation tax credits

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxReconciliationTaxCredits
concepts.review_reason: Tax reconciliation credits explain the effective tax provision and do not establish cash receipts or standalone operating adjustments.

children.label: Income tax credits and adjustments

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeTaxCreditsAndAdjustments
concepts.review_reason: Income tax credits and adjustments require the underlying tax reconciliation context; the amount alone does not establish a cash tax flow.

children.label: Noncash lease additions and lease expense disclosures
children.classification_note: Lease expenses differ from cash payments, and assets received for lease liabilities are noncash commencements. Do not add them to cash capex or debt proceeds.

children.label: Operating lease cost

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseCost
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease cost is an earnings measure distinct from cash lease payments and ROU-asset amortization; it is not an additional operating outflow.

children.label: Finance lease interest expense

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinanceLeaseInterestExpense
concepts.review_reason: Finance lease interest expense is an accrual measure; use the separate interest-payment concept for a cash disclosure.

children.label: Operating ROU assets obtained for lease liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForOperatingLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Operating ROU assets obtained for lease liabilities are noncash lease commencements; exclude them from cash capital expenditures.

children.label: Finance ROU assets obtained for lease liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:RightOfUseAssetObtainedInExchangeForFinanceLeaseLiability
concepts.review_reason: Finance ROU assets obtained for lease liabilities are noncash lease commencements, separate from principal payments.

children.label: Capital lease obligations incurred

concepts.name: us-gaap:CapitalLeaseObligationsIncurred
concepts.review_reason: Capital lease obligations incurred are a historical noncash financing measure; distinguish them from finance lease cash principal payments.

children.label: Acquisition consideration and purchase-price allocation
children.classification_note: Business purchase accounting and noncash consideration are separated from actual business acquisition and disposal cash flows.

children.label: Cash and noncash consideration disclosures
children.classification_note: Total consideration includes potentially noncash components. Equity consideration is not cash issuance proceeds and must not be added to net acquisition cash payments.

children.label: Total acquisition consideration transferred

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferred1
concepts.review_reason: Total consideration transferred can include cash, equity and contingent consideration; isolate the cash component before using an acquisition cash-flow measure.

children.label: Acquisition consideration — equity issued and issuable

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationConsiderationTransferredEquityInterestsIssuedAndIssuable
concepts.review_reason: Equity interests issued or issuable as acquisition consideration are a noncash component, not cash stock issuance proceeds.

children.label: Assets acquired and liabilities assumed
children.classification_note: Gross, net, identifiable and asset-class acquisition measures overlap; some are acquisition-date instant balances and others period transaction values. They are not cash-flow components to sum.

children.label: Fair value of assets acquired

concepts.name: us-gaap:FairValueOfAssetsAcquired
concepts.review_reason: Fair value of assets acquired measures acquisition value and can include assets financed through assumed liabilities or equity rather than cash.

children.label: Noncash or partly noncash acquisition — liabilities assumed

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionValueOfLiabilitiesAssumed1
concepts.review_reason: Acquisition liabilities assumed can represent noncash financing; identify their inclusion in total liabilities assumed before aggregating acquisition disclosures.

children.label: Noncash or partly noncash acquisition — assets acquired

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionValueOfAssetsAcquired1
concepts.review_reason: Assets acquired in a noncash or partly noncash acquisition include cash-financed and noncash-financed portions; the amount is not itself a cash payment.

children.label: Liabilities assumed

concepts.name: us-gaap:LiabilitiesAssumed1
concepts.review_reason: Liabilities assumed can overlap the acquisition-specific and identifiable-liability disclosures; it does not establish repayment cash outflow.

children.label: Acquired identifiable liabilities — acquisition-date balance

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiableAssetsAcquiredAndLiabilitiesAssumedLiabilities
concepts.review_reason: Acquired identifiable liabilities are instant acquisition-date balances; they are not a period cash payment or operating liability movement.

children.label: Acquired identifiable assets — acquisition-date balance

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiableAssetsAcquiredAndLiabilitiesAssumedAssets
concepts.review_reason: Acquired identifiable assets are instant acquisition-date balances; they are not equal to acquisition cash paid.

children.label: Acquired net identifiable assets — acquisition-date balance

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationRecognizedIdentifiableAssetsAcquiredAndLiabilitiesAssumedNet
concepts.review_reason: Net acquired identifiable assets and liabilities is an instant purchase-price-allocation measure, not acquisition net cash flow.

children.label: Noncash or partly noncash acquisition — intangible assets acquired
Noncash or partly noncash acquisition — net nonmonetary assets and liabilities

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoncashOrPartNoncashAcquisitionNetNonmonetaryAssetsAcquiredLiabilitiesAssumed1
concepts.review_reason: Net nonmonetary assets acquired and liabilities assumed is a net noncash acquisition measure, not a gross asset purchase or cash consideration.

children.label: Noncash or partly noncash acquisition — investments acquired
Noncash or partly noncash acquisition — fixed assets acquired
Noncash or partly noncash acquisition — other liabilities assumed
Goodwill acquisition and movement disclosures
children.classification_note: Acquired goodwill and purchase-accounting adjustments can be included in the total goodwill movement, which can also contain impairment and FX. These are not acquisition cash payments.

children.label: Goodwill acquired during period

concepts.name: us-gaap:GoodwillAcquiredDuringPeriod
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill acquired is an acquisition allocation amount, not the cash purchase price or a standalone investing outflow.

children.label: Goodwill purchase accounting adjustments

concepts.name: us-gaap:GoodwillPurchaseAccountingAdjustments
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill purchase-accounting adjustments alter acquisition measurement and need not involve additional cash consideration.

children.label: Goodwill period increase decrease

concepts.name: us-gaap:GoodwillPeriodIncreaseDecrease
concepts.review_reason: Total goodwill movement can include acquisitions, impairment, foreign exchange and other noncash changes; it is not acquisition cash paid.

children.label: Credit reserve, foreclosure and loan transfer disclosures
children.classification_note: Reserve use, collateral acquisition and portfolio transfers are not actual loan purchase/sale cash flows.

children.label: Credit reserve write-offs and acquired loan measurement
children.classification_note: Allowance write-offs are reserve-rollforward movements rather than new credit-loss expense or cash losses. Purchased-credit-deteriorated loan discounts are acquisition measurement adjustments.

children.label: Financing receivable allowance for credit losses write offs

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableAllowanceForCreditLossesWriteOffs
concepts.review_reason: Allowance write-offs consume an existing credit-loss reserve and do not by themselves establish a current-period provision expense or cash outflow.

children.label: Financing receivable write-offs excluding accrued interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossWriteoff
concepts.review_reason: Write-offs explicitly exclude accrued interest; distinguish this narrower allowance-rollforward scope from write-offs that may include it.

children.label: Purchased-credit-deteriorated receivable discount (premium)

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivablePurchasedWithCreditDeteriorationDiscountPremium
concepts.review_reason: Purchased-credit-deteriorated loan discount/premium reflects acquisition measurement; separate the purchase cash payment from subsequent accretion and credit-loss effects.

children.label: Foreclosures and real estate transfers
children.classification_note: Transfers into real estate, transfers out and foreclosure acquisitions are different noncash events and can overlap reserve or asset rollforwards.

children.label: Transfer to other real estate

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferToOtherRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Transfers into other real estate generally reflect collateral taken or asset reclassification; they are not cash real-estate acquisition payments.

children.label: Transfer of other real estate

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferOfOtherRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy defines this as transfers out of real estate owned in noncash transactions; do not treat it as real-estate sale proceeds.

children.label: Real estate acquisitions through foreclosures

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateAcquisitionsThroughForeclosures
concepts.review_reason: Real estate acquired through foreclosure settles a loan exposure without establishing a cash purchase; separate it from investing property payments.

children.label: Loan and investment reclassifications
children.classification_note: Transfers to/from held-for-sale or investment portfolios do not establish cash purchases or sales. The loan-transfer and receivable-reclassification concepts may overlap.

children.label: Portfolio loans and leases transferred to held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferOfPortfolioLoansAndLeasesToHeldForSale1
concepts.review_reason: Portfolio loans transferred to held for sale change classification without constituting loan sales or cash originations.

children.label: Held-for-sale loans transferred to portfolio

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferOfLoansHeldForSaleToPortfolioLoans1
concepts.review_reason: Loans transferred from held for sale to portfolio are a noncash reclassification, not a new investing loan purchase.

children.label: Financing receivable reclassification to held for sale

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableReclassificationToHeldForSale
concepts.review_reason: Receivables reclassified to held for sale are noncash portfolio movements that can overlap the supplied transfer-to-held-for-sale concept.

children.label: Transfer to investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferToInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Transfers into investments do not establish purchases for cash; identify the source asset and reclassification context.

children.label: Transfer of investments

concepts.name: us-gaap:TransferOfInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Transfers of investments are noncash movements whose direction and portfolios require context; do not infer sale or purchase cash flows.

children.label: Servicing asset additions
children.classification_note: Fair-value servicing asset additions may include retained servicing and other noncash recognition; do not presume a cash purchase.

children.label: Servicing asset at fair value additions

concepts.name: us-gaap:ServicingAssetAtFairValueAdditions
concepts.review_reason: Fair-value servicing-asset additions can arise from retained servicing or purchases; the disclosed addition is not necessarily a cash acquisition.

children.label: Noncash equity and dividend disclosures
children.classification_note: Noncash stock issuance, stock dividends and the instant dividend payable balance are distinct from cash issuance and cash dividend payments.

children.label: Fair value of stock issued in noncash financing

concepts.name: us-gaap:StockIssued1
concepts.review_reason: The taxonomy defines StockIssued1 as fair value of stock issued in noncash financing activities; do not map it to cash equity issuance proceeds.

children.label: Common stock dividends paid in stock
Dividends payable current and noncurrent

concepts.name: us-gaap:DividendsPayableCurrentAndNoncurrent
concepts.review_reason: Dividends payable is an instant liability balance, not cash dividends paid during the period.

children.label: OCI security remeasurement disclosures
children.classification_note: The supplied HTM-to-AFS transfer adjustment and AFS unrealized gain/loss concern OCI. They are not cash flows or automatically net-income reversal adjustments.

children.label: OCI adjustment on HTM to AFS transfers, before tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherComprehensiveIncomeReclassificationAdjustmentForHeldToMaturityTransferredToAvailableForSaleSecuritiesBeforeTax
concepts.review_reason: This is a pretax OCI adjustment on transferring HTM debt securities to AFS; it is not a cash security sale or an operating earnings reversal.

children.label: Debt securities available-for-sale unrealized gain loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtSecuritiesAvailableForSaleUnrealizedGainLoss
concepts.review_reason: AFS debt-security unrealized gain/loss is recognized in OCI under the taxonomy definition; do not reverse it from net income without an earnings component.

children.label: Funding rate and debt obligation disclosures
children.classification_note: The interest rate uses a percent unit and instant context. The repayment/penalty disclosure is not assumed to be cash principal alone; neither is added to debt cash-flow totals.

children.label: Debt weighted-average interest rate

concepts.name: us-gaap:DebtWeightedAverageInterestRate
concepts.review_reason: Debt weighted-average interest rate is an instant percent disclosure, not an interest payment or a monetary cash-flow amount.

children.label: FHLB advance repayments and penalties — disclosure

concepts.name: us-gaap:FederalHomeLoanBankAdvancesGeneralDebtObligationsDisclosuresRepaymentAndPenalties
concepts.review_reason: This debt-disclosure amount combines FHLB advance repayment and penalties; it is not necessarily principal cash repayment alone.
